title: Real MCP server probes: init/discovery/cancel/timeout/malformed/credential isolation (VC-201-086)
goal: VC-201-086 refuted: McpSpecProfile is a static catalog — registry_metadata hardcodes supports_list_changed=true before any server is contacted; its version list is stale relative to the wire (misses 2025-11-25 and 2025-06-18 that susi-core's real client speaks); negotiate() is pure list intersection — no initialize, discovery, cancellation, timeout, malformed-response, or credential-isolation probe exists; the profile has no production callers. Evidence: crates/susi-gmcp/src/tests/vc_201_086_mastery.rs.
